purpose: Software pipeline verification, unit test fixtures, and smoke training
generation_method: PIL procedural drawing with simulated geometric polygon jitter, laboratory tray background noise, defect contours, and deterministic seed indexing in scripts/prepare_dataset.py
scientific_notice: CRITICAL: This dataset consists of synthetic procedural fixtures. The 100% test accuracy obtained during training demonstrates neural network convergence on synthetic features, NOT real-world agronomic grading accuracy. Real-world agronomic validation is currently pending certified pulse dataset acquisition.
biological_boundary: Optical RGB grading assesses surface physical morphology only and cannot determine physiological seed germination rate, internal embryo viability (e.g., Tetrazolium test), moisture percentage, or regulatory seed lot certification.
